auto_deploy.required_evidence: Actual Auto Deploy/Preview/Git/Webhook/registry/API/scheduled triggers and queued deployments

runtime_configuration.required_evidence: Existing private C16 Settings JSON, Limits JSON and separate mount policy; file metadata and filtered field review

queue_and_workers.required_evidence: All C16/independent pilot roots, live jobs, ownership, unique executor and guardian locks

revision_and_digest.required_evidence: Actual image ID/RepoDigest/build provenance and deployment SHA; tags are not proof

private_network.required_evidence: Existing dedicated internal API network and exclusive members; shared coolify network is not accepted as proof

tls_dns_vpn.required_evidence: Exact trusted SAN/name/CA, private DNS, real VPN paths and RemoteAddr negative checks

oidc_and_devices.required_evidence: Exact issuer/callback, individual subject-role-course bindings, approved/revoked users/devices

backup_restore_rollback.required_evidence: Backup scope/freshness, isolated restore proof, pinned prior image and complete state/namespace/role rollback

coolify_driver.required_evidence: Existing Gate.Driver adapter covering exact resource type and single-resource/namespace replacement semantics

repository_build_settings.required_evidence: Read actual repository, branch, base directory, Dockerfile location, Compose location, raw/normal rendering and startup overrides in Coolify; no inferred values from artifact paths or tags.

compose_working_directory.required_evidence: Backend working_dir label key is reported present, but its value is not supplied; UI working_dir value not supplied either.

entrypoint_discrepancy.required_evidence: Match immutable running image Config.Entrypoint/Cmd to container settings and actual Coolify build/deploy record, privately classified against known startup vectors; root cause and operator intent not yet proven.
